stronger_left_out.name: Marree Man
stronger_left_out.reason: For: Wikivoyage Marree See entry and Flinders & Outback both name it; a famous 4.2 km geoglyph. Against: it cannot be seen from the ground and the experience is a charter flight from Marree (an operator), so a visitor 'goes' to nothing; only the flight reaches it.

stronger_left_out.name: Roxby Downs
stronger_left_out.reason: Mining town; the Flinders & Outback page lists the Roxbylink complex (visitor centre, library, pool) and a 3 km emu trail, i.e. civic facilities and tours. The distinct draw (Arid Recovery) is judged separately; the town itself is a service stop (rule 2).

stronger_left_out.name: Moomba
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 2: Wikivoyage says it is a company town closed to non-employees with no services.

stronger_left_out.name: Marla
stronger_left_out.reason: Roadhouse settlement; Wikivoyage Marla and the Flinders & Outback town page list only fuel, accommodation and Indulkana art centre (a separate place 40+ km away) - nothing to see or do in Marla itself for half an hour (rule 2).

stronger_left_out.name: Strzelecki Track
stronger_left_out.reason: A 475 km route, not a place: Wikivoyage describes the drive; its stops (Lyndhurst, Innamincka) are separate candidates. A road/vehicle route is not a spot (rule 3). Objection: Wikivoyage gives it its own article, but nothing to see or do at a single place.

stronger_left_out.name: Anne Beadell Highway
stronger_left_out.reason: Remote 4WD desert route needing permits, mentioned in passing on the Stuart Highway page; no visitor stop (rule 2)

stronger_left_out.name: Pimba
stronger_left_out.reason: Roadhouse hamlet; nothing to see beyond fuel and a meal.

stronger_left_out.name: Glendambo
stronger_left_out.reason: Roadhouse/motel stop; Wikivoyage names nothing to see or do.

stronger_left_out.name: Mount Hopeless
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage lists it only as a waypoint ('Oh poor you, have some hope'), with nothing to see or do.

stronger_left_out.name: Tirari Desert
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 3: a desert region crossed by a road, not a place; the cited page does not name it.

stronger_left_out.name: Kingoonya
stronger_left_out.reason: Tiny hamlet with a pub; nothing named to see or do except access to another place.

stronger_left_out.name: Coober Pedy Mail Run
stronger_left_out.reason: Tour/vehicle operator, not a place (COVERAGE: a spot is a place); link is dead

stronger_left_out.name: Lake Cadibarrawirracanna
stronger_left_out.reason: Remote salt lake with a passing mention only, no visitor facilities or description (rule 1,2)

stronger_left_out.name: Innamincka Station
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 2: Wikivoyage itself says it is on private land.

stronger_left_out.name: Coongie Lakes
stronger_left_out.reason: Duplicate of Malkumba–Coongie Lakes National Park (same wetland, kept under the park).

stronger_left_out.name: Painted Desert (South Australia)
stronger_left_out.reason: For: Wikivoyage names it, SA Heritage lists the Arckaringa Hills state heritage area, and Arckaringa Station offers a walk (~1.5 km) and lookout at sunset; distinct natural sight. Against: only one counted source (Wikivoyage Stuart Highway, 'all-wheel track'), sits on a private pastoral lease with restricted, fragile access, 120-150 km from Coober Pedy; no tourism-board page found.

stronger_left_out.name: Lake Torrens National Park
stronger_left_out.reason: Flinders & Outback page only describes a dry salt lake 200 km long; no visitor facilities, viewpoint, walk or access point is named by any source I found, and access is difficult, so there is nothing a visitor is directed to do or see (rule 2). Searched the Flinders & Outback page and web.

stronger_left_out.name: Wabma Kadarbu Mound Springs Conservation Park
stronger_left_out.reason: duplicate of The Bubbler and Blanche Cup (the park holds those springs; kept as one)

stronger_left_out.name: Merty Merty
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 1/2: listed only as a waypoint with no description; a station settlement.

stronger_left_out.name: Kalamurina Sanctuary
stronger_left_out.reason: For: AWC (the manager) describes a 679,000 ha wildlife sanctuary on the Warburton River with an interpretive walk on Outback Spirit pre-booked tours (April-October). Against: no tourism-board or guide source; third-party listings say camping is closed and entry is tours only, and AWC's own page allows booked self-drive at $40 per vehicle, so access sources conflict.

stronger_left_out.name: Lake Frome National Park
stronger_left_out.reason: Wrong region, not this region's: belongs to sa-flinders (reached from Balcanoona); also no counted source found in this pass.

stronger_left_out.name: Strzelecki Regional Reserve
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 3: a large reserve area; the Wikivoyage Strzelecki Track page does not list it as a stop.

stronger_left_out.name: Witchelina Nature Reserve
stronger_left_out.reason: Nature Foundation reserve with no counted source and access limited to members with bookings and fees; not open to the public (rule 2).

benchmark: No benchmark place lies in sa-outback (benchmarks are NZ). Negative benchmarks held: roadhouses, pubs-as-business, events and operators rejected; Marree Man (a gateway/flight-only sight) sent to review, like Pipiriki.
